parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: Department name. Must be 1 to 128 characters long. Supports Chinese, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: DeviceBelong
parameters.description:
Terminal device ownership. Valid values:

- **Personal**: Personal device.

- **Company**: Company device.

parameters.name: DeviceTypes
parameters.description: Collection of terminal device operating system types.

parameters.name: DlpStatuses
parameters.description: Collection of office data protection statuses.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: Terminal device name. Must be 1 to 128 characters long. Supports Chinese, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces. If you enter only an underscore (\_), the system returns all terminal devices whose names contain four-byte UTF-8 characters.

parameters.name: Mac
parameters.description: MAC address of the terminal device.

parameters.name: PaStatuses
parameters.description: Collection of private network access statuses.

parameters.name: SharingStatus
parameters.description:
Whether device sharing is enabled. Valid values:

- **true**: Sharing is enabled.

- **false**: Sharing is disabled.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: Username. Must be 1 to 128 characters long. Supports Chinese, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), asterisks (\*), at signs (@), and spaces.
